title.zh-CN: 季度业绩｜2026 Q1 数据海报

summary.en: Pack oversized lettering of different widths tightly with color blocks, using cropped edges to create density; keep the bottom information strip fixed.
summary.zh-CN: 多种宽度的巨字与色块紧密拼接，裁切边缘形成密度；底部信息条固定。

summary.en: Present the artwork first, then show how control points and parameters change it; each feature must have a visible before-and-after difference.
summary.zh-CN: 先呈现作品，再展示控制点和参数如何改变作品；功能必须有视觉前后差异。

title.zh-CN: 活动预热｜10 万美元 Make-a-thon

summary.en: Center the two brands as participant bubbles enter from the edges; collective responses lead into the event announcement.
summary.zh-CN: 双品牌居中，参与者气泡从周边入场；集体回应引出活动预告。

title.en: Figma — Bring code to the canvas

summary.en: The code-generated interface becomes a canvas object, placed beside design variants for comparison; it remains the same code layer after updates.
summary.zh-CN: 代码生成的界面作为画布对象，与设计变体并置比较；更新后仍是同一代码层。

summary.en: Make suggestions, apply styles and expand content for the same product; do not treat each result as an unrelated artwork.
summary.zh-CN: 对同一产品连续做建议、样式应用、内容扩充，不能把每次结果当无关作品。

title.zh-CN: 功能发布｜Config 2026 发布 Figma Motion

summary.en: Synchronize the motion preview with the timeline so the playhead position matches the object's state.
summary.zh-CN: 运动预览与时间线同步，播放头位置对应对象状态。

title.zh-CN: 季度业绩｜2026 Q2 回顾

summary.en: Keep feature windows in the foreground and oversized text texture in the background; do not merge these layers.
summary.zh-CN: 功能窗口在前景、巨字纹理在背景，两者层次不能合并。

summary.en: Letter fragments begin scattered, then assemble into a title as the progress line grows independently; on exit, the letters dissolve before progress completes.
summary.zh-CN: 字形碎片先乱后聚成标题，进度线独立持续增长；退出时字形先消散、进度后完成。

title.en: Figma — Roundtrip between code and canvas
title.zh-CN: 生态扩展｜MCP 新增 5 个合作方

summary.en: State the two-way workflow first, demonstrate the ecosystem's breadth with a horizontal tour of icons, and finally focus on the core tool.
summary.zh-CN: 先给往返主张，再用横向图标巡览证明生态范围，最终聚焦核心工具。

summary.en: Establish the event's identity through patterns and lettering at the start, quickly demonstrate participant outcomes with artwork in the middle, and announce the launch at the end.
summary.zh-CN: 开头图案与字形建立活动识别，中段作品快速证明参与产物，末尾说明已上线。

title.zh-CN: Google Drive 接入 Figma agent

summary.en: Read external feedback, make design changes, then produce a document recording the reasons for those changes, completing a read/write loop.
summary.zh-CN: 外部反馈被读取后产生设计修改，再输出记录变更原因的文档；形成读写闭环。

title.zh-CN: Figma node — connect frames into Weave workflows

summary.en: Turn a design frame into a connectable node, connect text and images to their respective slots, then branch the output into different use cases.
summary.zh-CN: 设计帧变成可连接节点，文本与图像分别连到槽位，输出再分叉到不同使用场景。

title.zh-CN: Figma × Codex · 设计与实现交接

summary.en: Select annotated design frames first, then pass that selection context to the implementation agent; implementation results must correspond to the selected screens.
summary.zh-CN: 先带着批注选择设计帧，再把选中上下文交给实现代理；实现结果对应选中的屏幕。

summary.en: Bring business, design and code evidence together in a document, use comments to drive reorganization, and finally turn it into an actionable implementation handoff specification.
summary.zh-CN: 文档聚合业务、设计和代码证据，评论驱动重排，最后转为可执行交接规格。

summary.en: Newly generated assets remain selectable, editable in color and animatable; demonstrate editability through these three stages.
summary.zh-CN: 新生成素材仍可选中、编辑颜色和编排动画；三阶段证明可编辑性。

summary.en: Present every example as selection → operation → result; highlighting the subject is only an intermediate state.
summary.zh-CN: 每个例子都按选区→操作→结果展示；主体高亮仅是中间状态。

summary.en: Pull back from letterform construction details to a readable title, then blur the title into the background while showing the date and website in the foreground.
summary.zh-CN: 从字形构造细节拉开到可读标题，再把标题虚化为背景，前景显示日期与网址。

summary.en: A glowing point activates action labels sequentially along a loop; each complete loop represents one workflow.
summary.zh-CN: 发光点沿环路依次激活动作标签，完整闭环对应一条工作流。

title.zh-CN: Linear — The product development system for teams and…

summary.en: Multiple task branches converge into a shared main path; pulling the camera back turns local relationships into a complete network.
summary.zh-CN: 多条任务支线汇入共同主干；镜头拉远让局部关系成为整体网络。

title.zh-CN: Linear Agent — ask anything, command everything

summary.en: Move an angled camera between the project and agent, using documents and relationship diagrams as evidence for the answers.
summary.zh-CN: 斜视镜头在项目和代理之间移动，用文档与关系图作为回答依据。

summary.en: Quickly list trigger conditions first, then explain output actions along the track; give triggers and results separate sections.
summary.zh-CN: 先快速枚举触发条件，再沿轨道解释输出动作；触发与结果分别占一个段落。

title.zh-CN: Linear — custom environments in coding sessions

summary.en: Present dark cards one at a time in angled close-ups, keeping each environment's fields connected within its card.
summary.zh-CN: 暗色卡片以倾斜近景逐张展示，卡片内各环境字段保持关联。

summary.en: Select weekly recurrence before showing the weekday multi-select, then set the time; after completion, summarize the rule in natural language in the overview.
summary.zh-CN: 先选周周期，才显示星期多选，再设时间；完成后总览用自然语言总结规则。

title.zh-CN: Linear — merge queue status in diffs

summary.en: This short clip contains only a local hover interaction: the main status stays unchanged, hovering reveals the elapsed waiting time, and moving away hides it.
summary.zh-CN: 短片只有局部 hover：主状态保持，悬停补充已经等待的时长，离开后隐藏。

title.zh-CN: Linear Diffs — code review inside Linear

summary.en: Select a change before viewing its diff, anchor the comment to a code line, and explicitly submit the review at the end.
summary.zh-CN: 先选变更再看差异，评论定位到代码行，最后明确提交评审。

summary.en: Keep code context above and the input and on-screen keyboard below; after submission, the keyboard exits and a processing state takes its place.
summary.zh-CN: 代码上下文保持在上方，输入与软键盘位于下方；提交后键盘退出、处理状态接替。

title.zh-CN: Lovable · 从 Slack 发起制作

summary.en: Messages from different speakers enter the same thread, and the assistant responds after the request
summary.zh-CN: 消息从不同发言者进入同一线程，助手回应在请求之后

summary.en: Multiple tool icons gather first, then become connector tags in the prompt field one by one
summary.zh-CN: 多个工具图标先聚合，之后逐个成为提示框中的连接器标签

summary.en: The first section builds aesthetic expectations through different design dimensions, and the second explains how they are achieved through actual interactions
summary.zh-CN: 前段用不同设计维度建立审美期待，后段用实际操作说明产生方式

summary.en: Open with skepticism to create an information gap, switch to the website to verify it firsthand, and return to the original post with a reply at the end
summary.zh-CN: 开头用质疑制造信息差，切到网站亲自验证，末尾回到原贴回应

summary.en: Foreground websites switch through a horizontal queue while the bottom input position stays fixed
summary.zh-CN: 前景网站按水平队列切换，底部输入位置保持稳定

summary.en: The heading remains largely fixed while soft shapes of different scales float and rotate around it
summary.zh-CN: 标题基本固定，四周不同尺度的柔软图形旋转漂浮

summary.en: Tasks begin flowing neatly, then become crowded; agents take over and restore organized division of work, contrasting the problem with its solution.
summary.zh-CN: 开头任务从整齐流动变拥挤，代理接管后恢复有序分工，构成问题与解决的反差。

title.en: Notion — Your agents. Now doing more.
title.zh-CN: Notion AI 大升级（Agents 等）

summary.en: The capability showcase has three sections: execution, model switching and connecting an existing subscription.
summary.zh-CN: 能力展示分为执行、换模型、连接已有订阅三个段落。

summary.en: The same task card persists while its status changes through Triage→Plan→Build→PR→Ship.
summary.zh-CN: 同一任务卡持续存在，状态按 Triage→Plan→Build→PR→Ship 改变。

title.en: Notion — Turn your best work into a skill
title.zh-CN: Notion Skills — teach agents how your team works

summary.en: Team sharing and local export are two distribution paths, each explained through a dialog before converging on usage.
summary.zh-CN: 团队共享与本地导出是两条分发路径，分别用弹窗说明后再汇合到使用。

title.zh-CN: Notion Skills API — skills for ChatGPT and Claude

summary.en: The same skill moves from document editing to repository synchronization to use by multiple agents, retaining its identity across containers.
summary.zh-CN: 同一技能从文档编辑到仓库同步再到多个代理消费，信息跨容器保持身份。

title.zh-CN: Notion Skills — export to local coding agents

summary.en: Quickly switch between multiple agent names to establish compatibility, then demonstrate it through a complete export and invocation.
summary.zh-CN: 多代理名称先快速切换说明兼容范围，再用一次完整导出与调用证明。

summary.en: Unfolding increases the visible body area, with a parent-child clipping relationship between sidebar and body.
summary.zh-CN: 展开后增加正文可视面积，侧栏与正文有父子裁切关系。

title.zh-CN: Notion — the backbone of your dock

summary.en: Desktop backgrounds and surrounding apps change rapidly while the core icon remains recognizable; finally, all other elements exit, leaving only the brand.
summary.zh-CN: 桌面背景和周边应用快速替换，核心图标始终可辨认；最后其余元素退出，仅剩品牌。

title.zh-CN: Notion as code — workspaces in TypeScript

summary.en: Enter the requirement before showing execution and code, then switch to the actual workspace result after deployment confirmation.
summary.zh-CN: 先写需求再展示执行与代码，部署确认后切到真实工作区成果。

summary.en: Attract attention with a large number first, then explain it in layers through time, curves and media screenshots
summary.zh-CN: 先用大数吸引，再用时间、曲线与媒体截图分层解释

summary.en: Coins emphasize the benefit, then a decreasing and replenished balance explains the cashback mechanism
summary.zh-CN: 硬币强调收益，随后用余额减少与补回解释返现机制

summary.en: Keep the canvas visible alongside the timeline and instruction area below it throughout, showing how production elements relate
summary.zh-CN: 画布始终与下方时间线、指令区域同时可见，展示制作关系

title.zh-CN: Higgsfield — plugin now in the ChatGPT app

summary.en: Select the plugin and skill before entering a cross-tool task, then reveal execution steps in order
summary.zh-CN: 先选插件与技能，再输入跨工具任务，执行步骤顺序出现

summary.en: Connect one entry point to multiple models, then connect them to multiple product outputs
summary.zh-CN: 从单入口连接多个模型，再接到多个产品成果

title.zh-CN: 研究突破｜数学与理论计算机科学成果

summary.en: Establish each research topic with a geometric diagram, then reduce it to a few points that connect to the next diagram.
summary.zh-CN: 每一研究主题用一种几何图建立，再归约为少量点以接入下个图。

summary.en: Show multiple plugins through repeating message → interaction → evidence units; keep the current tool identity at the upper right.
summary.zh-CN: 多个插件按主张→操作→证据的重复单元展示；右上角保持当前工具身份。

title.zh-CN: 产品预热｜Windows 相关预告

summary.en: Layer similar requests from different directions with slight tilts, building a sense of demand.
summary.zh-CN: 多条相似请求从不同方向叠入并微倾，累积需求压力。

summary.en: After finding a to-do item, show a suggestion, let the user edit and confirm it, then show the target chat receiving the message.
summary.zh-CN: 查到待办后先展示建议，再由用户修改并确认，最后显示目标聊天收到消息。

title.en: A flight through sun and moon

summary.en: Start the forward movement with radially stretching stars to establish speed, then let the sun and crescent moon take over the center in sequence.
summary.zh-CN: 推进先由星点径向拉伸建立速度，再让太阳与月牙依次接管中心。

summary.en: Repeated lateral movement finds different phone groups, introducing voices like a cast roll call.
summary.zh-CN: 通过重复横移寻找不同手机组，像演员点名一样介绍声音。

summary.en: An individual's writing first triggers changes in the world, then the story moves from a single ideal to many people's different futures.
summary.zh-CN: 先以个体书写触发世界变化，再从单一理想转向多人的多种未来。

title.zh-CN: ChatGPT Desktop — now in preview on Linux

summary.en: Show the coding task first, then request that the code be organized into a document; open the result to verify cross-application delivery.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示代码任务，再要求将代码整理成文档；打开结果验证跨应用交付。

summary.en: Show a static request becoming an animated image first, then slide cards horizontally to expand the range of capabilities.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示静态需求到动态图，再用卡片横移扩展能力范围。

summary.en: Keep the main background moving slowly while replacing copy at the same position.
summary.zh-CN: 主体背景持续缓慢运动，文案在同一落点替换。

summary.en: Give explicit course requirements first, then demonstrate completeness through a contents page, charts and exercise pages
summary.zh-CN: 先给明确课程要求，结果用目录、图表、练习页证明完整性

summary.en: A successful conversation first becomes a skill entry, then joins a list of skills that can be enabled
summary.zh-CN: 好会话先成为技能条目，再进入可启用列表

summary.en: Show the historical point that can be branched before copying the shared context
summary.zh-CN: 先显示可分支的历史位置，再复制共享上下文

summary.en: Split one input into multiple task panels, unfolding them horizontally in depth to express parallel execution
summary.zh-CN: 一个输入分解为多个任务面板，横向纵深展开表达并行

title.zh-CN: 把重复工作设成自动任务

summary.en: Show conditions and actions in pairs, and execute only after both are filled in
summary.zh-CN: 条件与动作成对出现，填完两部分才能执行

title.zh-CN: Manus 做的网站能装成桌面 app

summary.en: Detach the same website from the browser frame into an independent window, preserving content identity
summary.zh-CN: 同一网站从浏览器框中脱离成为独立窗口，内容身份保持

title.zh-CN: Manus Agents — your personal Manus, now inside your…

summary.en: Keep the assistant within the original chat container and return a result card after assets are sent
summary.zh-CN: 助手存在于原聊天容器内，发送素材后返回结果卡

title.zh-CN: Cloud Computer：部署与使用云电脑

summary.en: Explain the persistent execution environment first, then prove it through three examples: bots, scraping and deployment
summary.zh-CN: 先解释持久执行环境，再用机器人、抓取、部署三个实例证明

summary.en: Start with the calendar's overall distribution, then push in on one task to explain its settings
summary.zh-CN: 日历先给全局分布，推近单个任务说明设置

summary.en: Keep the same task visible as device width changes rather than switching to a new task
summary.zh-CN: 设备宽度变化时同一任务继续显示，不是切成新任务

title.zh-CN: Claude Code Security — vulnerability scans and patches

summary.en: Preserve the full entry → scan → issues → fix → PR sequence, revealing deeper result levels as it progresses.
summary.zh-CN: 入口→扫描→问题→修复→PR 顺序必须完整，结果层级随深入而展开。

summary.en: Keep the three column positions fixed while changing internal textures and L-shape orientations in discrete steps; switching assets does not mean translating the entire tile.
summary.zh-CN: 三列位置保持稳定，内部纹理与 L 形朝向离散切换；切换素材不等于整体图块平移。

summary.en: Reveal the product name letter by letter only after the character reaches the sign, establishing cause and effect between movement and letters.
summary.zh-CN: 角色到达灯牌后才逐字出现产品名，动作与字母有因果。

title.en: A workspace for multiple coding sessions

summary.en: Expand the main window first, then grow it from one column into side-by-side preview and code; panels remain child layers of the same workspace.
summary.zh-CN: 主窗口先展开，随后从单列长成预览与代码并列；面板是同一工作区子层。

title.zh-CN: Claude Design — prototypes and slides by chat

summary.en: Let the user enter their intent first, show the result next, then demonstrate local edits and export; the result must appear after the submit action.
summary.zh-CN: 先让用户输入意图，再展示成果，最后演示局部修改与导出；成果出现必须晚于提交动作。

title.zh-CN: 幕后内容上线｜The making of Claude Code

summary.en: Layer windows in sequence, with the central heading covering the top layer last; retain recognizable edges of surrounding content.
summary.zh-CN: 窗口按先后层叠，中央标题最后覆盖上层；外围内容维持可辨认边缘。

summary.en: Establish an atlas context first, then let different media share the silhouette of the number 5; recognition relies on a stable shape rather than fixed texture.
summary.zh-CN: 前段建立图册语境，中段让不同媒介共享数字 5 轮廓；观众识别依赖稳定外形而非固定纹理。

summary.en: Match similar geometry such as arcs, rings and pointers across shots; these are different assets, not a single object's trajectory.
summary.zh-CN: 通过弧线、圆环、指针等相似几何跨镜头匹配；它们是不同素材，不建立同一物体轨迹。

summary.en: Establish agent capabilities through proactive reminder → user authorization → task result rather than simply scrolling chat.
summary.zh-CN: 以主动提醒→用户授权→任务结果建立代理能力，而不是只展示聊天滚动。

summary.en: Expand the same central circle from a button into an image window, then contract it back into a button, preserving spatial identity.
summary.zh-CN: 同一中心圆从按钮扩张为影像窗口，再收回按钮；保持空间身份连续。

title.zh-CN: Claude — computer use in Cowork and Claude Code

summary.en: Complete each task through phone request → desktop execution → phone confirmation, repeating this structure three times with progressively developing content.
summary.zh-CN: 每个任务按手机请求→桌面执行→手机确认闭环，三次重复同一语法但内容递进。

summary.en: Carry a business question through multiple tool calls: data explains what happened, workflows explain why, and slides support sharing.
summary.zh-CN: 以业务问题贯穿多工具调用：数据说明发生什么，流程说明为何，幻灯片负责分享。

summary.en: The character pulls scattered terminals together, expressing multiple tasks entering a single view.
summary.zh-CN: 角色牵引散落终端收拢，表达多任务进入同一视图。

title.en: One topic across documents and designs
title.zh-CN: Claude — decks, docs, and designs in chat

summary.en: Derive multiple design sizes from slides with the same jacket theme, then turn them into a document, preserving content identity across formats.
summary.zh-CN: 同一夹克主题从幻灯片派生多尺寸设计，再转为文档，内容身份跨格式保留。

title.en: From a wish to a budget

summary.en: Establish a specific life aspiration first, assess its feasibility through data, then return to the life outcome.
summary.zh-CN: 先建立具体生活愿望，再用数据判断可行性，最后回到生活结果。

title.en: Search across people, places and things
title.zh-CN: Search On 2020｜制作方动效集锦 · 34.6 秒

summary.en: Use dots, capsules and lines as shared primitives, moving from abstract categories to search results.
summary.zh-CN: 点、胶囊、线构成共享原语，从抽象类别转为搜索结果。

title.zh-CN: Android Drop — Find Hub, Motion Assist, Gemini

summary.en: Each feature consists of a main card and a small attached feedback element.
summary.zh-CN: 每个功能由一个主体卡和一个依附的小反馈组成。

summary.en: Advance each chapter through email context → interaction → result, maintaining subject and recipient continuity.
summary.zh-CN: 每章按邮件上下文→操作→结果推进，保留主题和收件人连续性。

title.en: A new identity assembled from particles

summary.en: Disintegrate the old text into particles, let them flow directionally, then reassemble them into the new name.
summary.zh-CN: 旧文字解体为粒子，粒子带方向性流动后重组新名称。

title.en: A search box for fuller intent
title.zh-CN: Google Search (AI upgrade) — At #GoogleIO last month,…

summary.en: Expand a short search bar into a multiline question field, expressing a shift from keywords to complete intent.
summary.zh-CN: 从短搜索栏扩大为多行问题框，体现由关键词到完整意图。

summary.en: Photo tiles form a number together, and nonuniform scaling changes its overall aspect ratio while internal tiles follow the parent transform.
summary.zh-CN: 照片块共同组成数字，整体非均匀缩放改变宽高比，内部图块随父变换。

title.en: Search categories in a point cloud
title.zh-CN: 同项目 5 秒短预览 · 5.0 秒

summary.en: Reconfigure dots into people, places and objects in sequence, with colors following the categories.
summary.zh-CN: 点群按人物、地点、物品依次重构，颜色跟随类别。

summary.en: Connect musical performance and dance steps through circular records, horn bells and petals.
summary.zh-CN: 用圆形唱片、喇叭口、花瓣把音乐演奏与舞步串联。

summary.en: The question includes a task and time constraints, and results address each constraint in turn.
summary.zh-CN: 问题包含任务和时间限制，结果逐项回应这些限制。

summary.en: Characters land on the previous character one by one, with the entire stack swaying slightly after contact.
summary.zh-CN: 角色逐个落在上一角色上，接触后整体轻微摆动。

title.zh-CN: Grok Bot · Starship 邀请活动

summary.en: Use the reward to attract attention, immediately explain it with on-site footage, then present participation steps and examples.
summary.zh-CN: 以奖励吸引注意，马上用现场画面解释奖励，再给出参与动作和实例。

title.en: A configured assistant becomes a template

summary.en: Carry the same assistant name and avatar through settings, the public page and the recipient's view.
summary.zh-CN: 同一助手的名称和头像贯穿设置、公开页面和接收方。

summary.en: Keep both brands aligned and fixed while the background flows continuously without competing with the text.
summary.zh-CN: 两枚品牌固定对齐，背景持续流动，避免抢文字。

title.zh-CN: Grok Bot can now search, read, and monitor X.

summary.en: Show the multiple retrieved sources first, then condense them into a thematic summary.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示被检索的多个来源，再压缩为主题汇总。

title.en: User input resumes an agent task
title.zh-CN: Grok Bot · 对话内填表与登录

summary.en: The agent hands control to the user only when authentication is encountered; the workflow resumes after user input.
summary.zh-CN: 代理遇到认证才转给用户；用户提供输入后流程恢复。

title.en: A voice announcement over moving color

summary.en: Keep the heading's position and size fixed, with motion coming primarily from the continuously flowing background.
summary.zh-CN: 标题保持位置与大小，运动主要来自背景连续流动。

summary.en: Attach the voice overlay to the phone, then move from the response to a specific task and document.
summary.zh-CN: 语音浮层附着于手机，回应后落到具体任务和文档。

title.en: A briefing becomes a voice note
title.zh-CN: Grok Bot — it can send you voice notes

summary.en: Specify content and time first, then add the output format and turn the result into a voice card.
summary.zh-CN: 先规定内容和时间，再补充输出形式，结果变成语音卡。

title.en: A character presents a payment card

summary.en: The character looks toward the card as it rotates continuously around its vertical axis.
summary.zh-CN: 角色目光朝向卡片，卡片绕垂直轴连续翻转。

title.en: A request and answer on the lock screen

summary.en: Show the human request first, followed by the assistant's prepared result, using timing to express a response.
summary.zh-CN: 先出现人类请求，再出现助手准备好的结果，时间顺序表达回应。

summary.en: Keep both brands stationary, with fluid and lighting changes providing the only main movement.
summary.zh-CN: 双品牌静止，流体与光影变化构成唯一主体运动。

summary.en: Keep the marks fixed without jumping while bright background areas pass slowly behind them, emphasizing the partnership identity.
summary.zh-CN: 标识固定不跳动，背景亮部缓慢穿过，强调合作身份。

summary.en: Explain cross-session memory through three states: recording → browsing → later retrieval.
summary.zh-CN: 以记录→浏览→后来读取三个状态说明跨会话记忆。

title.en: From prompt to a published app
title.zh-CN: Grok — one prompt to a published app

summary.en: Demonstrate actual interaction after generation first, then switch to desktop to show another type of publishable application.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示生成后能实际操作，再切到桌面展示另一类可发布应用。

title.en: One task across phone and desktop
title.zh-CN: Kimi Work — remote control from your phone

summary.en: The phone sends one task, and the desktop progressively searches, finds a local document, edits it and sends it.
summary.zh-CN: 手机发出同一个任务，桌面逐步搜索、找到本地文档、编辑并发送。

summary.en: Turn written strokes into discrete points, then form multiple network structures and extend them into a knowledge atlas.
summary.zh-CN: 由书写笔画变成离散点，再组成多份网络结构，延伸到知识图集。

title.zh-CN: Kimi Web Bridge - Kimi's browser extension.

summary.en: Place browser actions and terminal feedback side by side to show the correspondence between the agent's plan and page results.
summary.zh-CN: 浏览器操作和终端反馈并排，体现代理计划与页面结果的对应。

title.en: A world connected by computational fragments

summary.en: Connect multiple themes through code strips and offset slices, expressing the relationship between the physical world and computation.
summary.zh-CN: 多个主题以代码条带和错位切片连接，表达物理世界与计算的关联。

summary.en: Ask a question before showing the corresponding result for each capability, rather than playing outputs without context
summary.zh-CN: 每个能力先提问、再出现对应结果，不能只播放无上下文成果

title.en: Code is tested by a visible simulation

summary.en: Show specific constraints first, then explanations and code, and finally the running results side by side.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示具体约束，再显示解释和代码，最后并排运行结果。

title.en: A release told in product chapters

summary.en: Open each chapter with a pixel symbol and short phrase, then illustrate it with one product action.
summary.zh-CN: 每章用像素符号和短句开场，再用一个产品动作举例。

title.zh-CN: 四手机并列：应用生成能力演示

summary.en: Place four equal-height phones side by side on a shared background, with each progressing independently
summary.zh-CN: 四个等高手机并列，共用背景而各自独立推进

summary.en: Follow a short building section with a longer phone interaction to demonstrate the result's usability
summary.zh-CN: 短建造段后用较长手机操作展示成果可用性

summary.en: Establish context through growth first, then move the building entry point from computer to phone
summary.zh-CN: 先用增长建立背景，再把构建入口从电脑移到手机

summary.en: Use calls from multiple industries to establish the same problem in the opening, then present a single glowing sphere as the solution in the middle
summary.zh-CN: 前段用多个行业来电建立同一问题；中段单一光球作为解决方案

summary.en: Introduce measurement dimensions first, then explain capabilities through specific text changes
summary.zh-CN: 先介绍测量维度，再用具体文本变化解释能力

summary.en: Move from an open-ended request to controllable sections, tempo and key, ending with the waveform and finished piece
summary.zh-CN: 从开放式请求进入可控制的段落、速度、调性，最后落到波形与作品

title.zh-CN: ElevenMusic — Today we are launching ElevenMusic, a…

summary.en: Focus on one song from an existing music library, then expand into more works through prompts and style tags
summary.zh-CN: 从已有音乐库聚焦一首歌，再通过提示和风格标签扩展更多作品

summary.en: Establish context with figures and endorsements before entering the actual product, giving each of three business lines its own visual system
summary.zh-CN: 数字与背书建立背景后进入实际产品，三条业务线分别配自己的视觉系统

title.zh-CN: Flows Agent — describe it, the agent wires the workflow

summary.en: Convert natural language into node dependencies first, and make output nodes wait for upstream assets to finish
summary.zh-CN: 自然语言先转为节点依赖，输出节点应等待上游素材完成

summary.en: Explain participation after announcing the event, then expand the mapping between rankings and rewards
summary.zh-CN: 活动发布后说明参与方式，再展开排名和奖励的映射

summary.en: Scatter separate state shapes before assembling them into a map, expressing a shift from noise to structured information
summary.zh-CN: 零散州形先分散再拼成地图，表示从噪声到结构化信息

summary.en: Push from the terminal overview into the action form, then fill in amount, leverage and risk conditions in order before submitting
summary.zh-CN: 从全局终端推近操作表单，依次填写金额、杠杆、风险条件后才提交

summary.en: Pose the judgment question first, then focus the complex terminal into a two-choice interaction
summary.zh-CN: 先给判断问题，再把复杂终端聚焦为二选一操作

summary.en: After form selection, compress the countdown through jumps, showing the claim action only when it reaches zero
summary.zh-CN: 表单选择后倒计时压缩跳变，到零后才出现领取

summary.en: Keep the agent on the left and simulator on the right in the same view, with results occurring inside the controlled app
summary.zh-CN: 左侧代理与右侧模拟器同屏，操作结果发生在受控应用中

summary.en: New-repository and sync entry points lead to the same repository list, then PR review
summary.zh-CN: 仓库从新建或同步两种入口进入同一列表，再进入PR审查

summary.en: Follow abstract messages about code configuration with a running dashboard to demonstrate process observability
summary.zh-CN: 代码配置的抽象主张后必须配运行看板，证明过程可观测

title.zh-CN: Cursor Multitask / Subagents — /multitask in the new…

summary.en: Add multiple tasks to the same session, with a fixed work-item panel showing the parallel task count
summary.zh-CN: 同一会话追加多任务，工作项面板固定标明并行数量

summary.en: Attach annotations to target elements, keeping numbers and comments in one-to-one correspondence
summary.zh-CN: 标注附着在目标元素上，编号和批注保持一一对应

title.zh-CN: Cursor SDK — We’re introducing the Cursor SDK so you…

summary.en: Write code progressively, then shrink it into the left column while the terminal on the right executes the same configuration
summary.zh-CN: 代码从少到多写出后缩为左栏，右栏终端执行相同配置

summary.en: Top-level planning creates tasks, which branch further into subplans and worker nodes
summary.zh-CN: 顶层规划先产生任务，任务继续分叉为子规划与工作节点

title.zh-CN: Cursor Figma Component Creation — Cursor can now…

summary.en: Inspect the existing design system and variables before creating artboards, rather than freely drawing a similar-looking image
summary.zh-CN: 先查已有设计系统与变量，后创建画板而不是自由画一个相似图

summary.en: Show the same result across devices first, then focus on organization and review capabilities on the tablet
summary.zh-CN: 相同成果先跨设备展示，之后聚焦平板中的整理与审查能力

title.zh-CN: Cursor Builds — cloud agents start 3x faster

summary.en: Start both groups simultaneously but advance them at different speeds, with the new workflow showing results first
summary.zh-CN: 两组同时开始但进度速度不同，新流程先显示成果

summary.en: Present each feature as a one-sentence message on black followed by a short interaction on white, maintaining a regular rhythm
summary.zh-CN: 每项功能用黑底一句主张接白底短操作，保持节奏规律

title.zh-CN: Cursor — start a web app and deploy to Vercel

summary.en: Show available repositories first, then emphasize starting from scratch; reveal the preview only after input
summary.zh-CN: 先展示可选仓库，再强调从零创建；输入后才出现预览

title.zh-CN: Cursor · 从手机控制电脑代理

summary.en: Authorize pairing first, then show the same message and result at both ends
summary.zh-CN: 先授权配对，随后同一消息和结果出现在两端

summary.en: Complete infrastructure-building steps one by one before revealing the app preview
summary.zh-CN: 构建基础设施步骤先逐项完成，之后出现应用预览

summary.en: Results include interactive charts whose data tooltips respond to the pointer, rather than merely scaling the entire chart.
summary.zh-CN: 结果包含可操作图表；指针进入后数据提示响应，不能只让图表整体缩放。

summary.en: Slide spheres along one horizontal axis, clipping both ends at the viewport; slightly enlarge the active sphere and reveal its text
summary.zh-CN: 球体沿同一水平轴滑动，视口裁剪两侧，活动球体轻微放大并出现文字

summary.en: Separate event triggers and scheduled triggers into two complete examples, each with condition → execution → output.
summary.zh-CN: 事件触发与定时触发分成两个完整示例；每个都有条件→执行→产物。

title.zh-CN: Perplexity Projects — hubs for ongoing work

summary.en: Files and multiple tasks belong to the same project rather than appearing as unrelated floating cards.
summary.zh-CN: 文件与多个任务归属于同一项目，任务不是互不相关的漂浮卡片。

summary.en: Keep navigation anchored at the top while only the central mask expands; separate internal imagery from container dimensions.
summary.zh-CN: 导航保持顶部锚定，只有中心遮罩扩大；内部影像与容器尺寸分开。

title.zh-CN: Perplexity Computer 能完全本地跑在 Mac 上

summary.en: Show the execution location before running the task, then demonstrate local operation through a result report and to-do list.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示运行位置再执行任务，用结果报告和待办列表证明本地操作。

summary.en: Branch the same question to multiple models, then merge completed answers into a comparison table; do not reduce this to three serial steps.
summary.zh-CN: 多模型从同一问题分叉，完成后合流为对照表；不能简化为三个串行步骤。

title.zh-CN: Perplexity Computer — one agent for end-to-end projects

summary.en: Use the same task entry point for different output types, with successive examples demonstrating breadth.
summary.zh-CN: 相同任务入口承载不同输出类型，连续案例展示能力广度。

title.zh-CN: Perplexity AI / Snowflake Integration — Computer now…

summary.en: Introduce a question from existing data cards, then show query and report evidence after connecting the data source.
summary.zh-CN: 从已有数据卡引入问题，连接数据源之后展示查询与报告证据。

title.zh-CN: Deep Research — now native inside Computer

summary.en: Delegate the research request to subtasks, with the report following retrieval; present conclusions separately from sources.
summary.zh-CN: 研究请求交给子任务，报告必须晚于检索；结论与来源分开展示。

title.zh-CN: Computer for Counsel — Perplexity for lawyers

summary.en: Establish the domain, show input and sources, then provide three specific business outputs.
summary.zh-CN: 领域定位后展示输入与来源，再给三种具体业务产物。

title.en: Perplexity — Computer works wherever you do
title.zh-CN: Perplexity Computer now works in email

summary.en: Trigger the task by email and return results to the same thread; attachments are input dependencies.
summary.zh-CN: 通过邮件触发任务，结果回到同一邮件线程；附件是输入依赖。

title.zh-CN: Perplexity — Portable Computer on NVIDIA DGX Spark

summary.en: Arrange local tools in a ring around the device, with cloud models on a separate layer; connectors indicate escalation when needed rather than default data transmission.
summary.zh-CN: 本地工具围绕设备成环，云模型另置一层；连线表示按需提升而非数据默认外传。

title.zh-CN: Perplexity Computer — hybrid cloud and local compute

summary.en: Inspect sensitive information before choosing a local or cloud path, giving the two execution locations explicit responsibilities.
summary.zh-CN: 先检查敏感信息，再决定本地或云端路径，两个运行位置有明确职责。

summary.en: Complete installation progress before showing the local tool network; require confirmation before cloud escalation.
summary.zh-CN: 安装进度完成后才能出现本地工具网络；云提升先经过确认。

title.zh-CN: Computer — effort controls in the model selector

summary.en: Increase one slider through levels, synchronizing the level name, model description and fill length.
summary.zh-CN: 一个滑杆逐档增加，档名、模型说明与填充长度同步变化。

summary.en: Search terms trigger a suggestion list; selecting an action collapses the list and turns the capsule into a parameterized command.
summary.zh-CN: 搜索词触发建议列表，选中操作后列表收起、胶囊转为参数化命令。

summary.en: Phone text is the input source and the computer document the destination; changes focus on text selection and pasting while device frames remain largely stable.
summary.zh-CN: 手机文本为输入来源，电脑文档为目标；核心变化在文本选择与粘贴，设备外框基本稳定。

title.en: From prompt to bulk CMS updates

summary.en: Move from a keyboard close-up to a dark input field, then cut to the CMS table after typing finishes. Reveal blue outlines along table rows to show one request affecting multiple records.
summary.zh-CN: 从键盘近景过渡到暗色输入框，输入完成后切到 CMS 表格。让蓝框顺着行列表出现，说明一条请求影响多条数据。

title.zh-CN: 用 MCP 迁移到 Framer

summary.en: Fix the front window at the upper right and the rear window at the lower left, with matching perspective directions. Collapse the rear window to a point before expanding it along a diagonal axis.
summary.zh-CN: 前窗固定在右上，后窗位于左下。两者保持相同透视方向，后窗收起时先缩为一点，再沿斜轴展开。

title.en: Teach the agent a reusable style

summary.en: Open by typing font and quotation-mark rules into the input field, then show completed pages so viewers understand the rules affect the full page set.
summary.zh-CN: 开场在输入框中接连输入字体和引号规则；接着展示已完成页面，使观众知道这些规则影响的是整套页面。

summary.en: Arrange three templates horizontally, showing the center card fully and only dimmed portions of the side cards. Slide the entire track horizontally when switching, restoring center-card brightness only after it settles.
summary.zh-CN: 三张模板横排，中央卡完整显示，两侧只露一部分并压暗。切换时整条轨道横向滑动，到位后才恢复中央卡的亮度。

title.en: A product launch connected by blue light

summary.en: Opening light introduces branching and publishing, the middle shows specific editing results, and the later section abstracts interface language into glass symbols. Blue serves as both selection state and a material motif throughout.
summary.zh-CN: 开场光线引出分支和发布操作，中段放具体编辑结果，后段再把界面语言抽象成玻璃符号。蓝色既是选中状态，也是全片材质线索。

title.en: A sentence drawn by glass light

summary.en: Fix the heading on the central axis and reveal it word by word; extend a narrow glass strip from left to right, with the brightest point crossing the heading slightly later.
summary.zh-CN: 标题固定在画面中轴，按词逐步出现；狭长玻璃条从左向右延伸，最亮的光点稍后越过标题。

summary.en: Keep the purple outline and component names fixed to make five rapid demonstrations feel like one toolkit. Change only internal objects between segments, not the presentation stage.
summary.zh-CN: 固定紫色描边与组件名称，使五段快速演示看起来属于同一套工具。每次切换只更换内部对象，不移动展示舞台。

title.en: An agent payment with human approval

summary.en: Install and connect the agent first, then request an itinerary change in chat, show the cost and move to phone confirmation. Repeat the cost and merchant name across interfaces to identify the same request.
summary.zh-CN: 先安装并连接 agent，随后用聊天提出行程调整，显示费用，再转到手机确认。费用和商户名称跨界面重复，帮助理解是同一笔请求。

title.en: A treasury workflow in floating panels

summary.en: Move from a notification into the balance, then send a payment, create a card and perform chat actions before returning to the overview. Center only one action panel at a time, handing off to the next scene after confirmation.
summary.zh-CN: 从通知进入余额，再发送付款、创建卡片、对话操作，最后回到总览。每次只让一张操作面板居中，确认后再移交给下一个场景。

title.en: A serif typeface as an engineering specimen

summary.en: Enter a blue technical drawing through a triangular mark, then enlarge a single letter outline. Fine lines, dimensions and control points explain stroke structure without overpowering the glyph.
summary.zh-CN: 以三角标志进入蓝底工程图，再放大单字轮廓。细线、尺寸标记和控制点服务于笔画结构，不能盖过字形。

title.en: A stable name for changing models

summary.en: Explain the capability in one sentence, then show a task-to-model mapping table or command. Avoid consecutive explanatory sentences; follow each concept immediately with a concrete usage example.
summary.zh-CN: 一句话先说明能力，再给任务和模型的对应表或命令。避免连续堆叠说明句，每个概念后紧跟一个具体用法。

title.en: Drop an image into a note
title.zh-CN: 本周更新：Notes 支持图片

summary.en: Let the full checklist be read first, then drag an image from the right side of the desktop below the note. Make the file follow the cursor; on release, expand the image and increase the note window's height with its content.
summary.zh-CN: 先让清单完整可读，从桌面右侧拖动图片到笔记下方。文件跟随光标，释放后图片展开，笔记窗口随内容增高。

title.zh-CN: Genspark AI Workspace 3.0: Introducing Genspark Claw

summary.en: Present workflows, team chat, meetings, mobile voice and the browser assistant in separate sections. Use a consistent short-heading-then-interface rhythm, re-establishing the scene when changing capabilities.
summary.zh-CN: 工作流、团队聊天、会议、手机语音和浏览器助手分段出现。统一采用短标题接界面的节奏，切换能力时重新建立场景。

title.zh-CN: AI Grand Prix 无人机赛

summary.en: Assemble scattered black stroke segments into AI–GP, with orange-red control frames, cross-lines and alignment points appearing alongside them. Align the subtitle and organizer vertically.
summary.zh-CN: 黑色笔画从分散段落组合成 AI–GP，橙红控制框、交叉线和定位点随笔画一起出现。副标题和主办方上下对齐。

title.en: An application grows into a system

summary.en: Generate a customer dashboard from one input, then add an agent, external tools and file Q&A. Return to the same work object with each added capability, and pull back at the end to a network of multiple apps.
summary.zh-CN: 先从一条输入生成客户看板，再加入 agent、外部工具和文件问答。每次能力增加都回到同一工作对象，结尾拉远看多个应用的网络。

title.en: Security data from scale to result

summary.en: Left-align the heading and color Cybersecurity Data orange; illuminate part of the dot matrix below. Then turn the full screen orange, rapidly increase a large white number and reveal vulnerabilities.
summary.zh-CN: 标题左对齐，Cybersecurity Data 使用橙色；下方点阵从局部亮起。随后整屏转橙色，白色大数字快速增长，再出现 vulnerabilities。

title.en: A people search becomes a directory

summary.en: Introduce avatars around the central heading in sequence, with similar sizes and short identity labels. Keep the heading on two lines and color the brand's line orange.
summary.zh-CN: 头像依次围绕中央标题出现，头像大小接近并带简短身份标签。标题保留两行，品牌所在行用橙色。

title.zh-CN: The web wasn’t built for AI agents

summary.en: Stacked webpages represent input complexity, with orange modules connecting the flow to structured content. Match webpages and code through adjacent or consecutive shots to make input-output relationships readable.
summary.zh-CN: 网页堆叠代表输入复杂度，橙色模块把流程接向结构化内容。网页和代码用相邻或连续镜头对应，形成可读的输入输出关系。

title.en: From a brand URL to an ad family
title.zh-CN: Ad Studio：贴链接出整套广告

summary.en: After link input, gather surrounding posters into logos, colors, fonts and product assets. Products enter a combination ring, and the ad matrix unfolds only after the count rises.
summary.zh-CN: 输入链接后收拢周围海报，组织成标志、颜色、字体和产品素材。产品进入组合环，计数增长后才展开广告矩阵。

title.en: A collaborative graph writes its own title

summary.en: Multiple colored cursors trace letter curves, leaving black node endpoints on the glyphs. Collapse the completed heading into one empty node to connect the visual metaphor to actual interaction.
summary.zh-CN: 多支彩色光标描出字母曲线，黑色节点端点留在字形上。完整标题随后收成单张空白节点，把图形隐喻接入真实操作。

title.en: Two requests turn a sketch into animation
title.zh-CN: 在 Grok 里把草图变卡通

summary.en: The first request turns a sketch into a character sheet, and the second turns that result into animation. Scroll the chat upward as new results enter from below, retaining the connection to the previous message.
summary.zh-CN: 第一条请求把草图变成人物设定图，第二条再把该结果变为动画。聊天视图向上滚动，新结果从底部进入，保留上一条消息的联系。

title.en: A continuous zoom demonstrates vector clarity

summary.en: Push from the full poster into a planet, then a curve on its yellow outline. Keep increasing magnification while edges remain smooth, anchoring the zoom on the same detail.
summary.zh-CN: 从完整海报推进到行星，再到黄色轮廓的一条曲线。倍率持续增加，但边缘始终平滑；放大中心保持在同一细节上。

title.en: A wireframe tunnel introduces a partnership

summary.en: Expand perspective lines from a small central opening into a four-sided grid; after moving forward, narrow it toward both sides to leave symmetrical positions for the two logos.
summary.zh-CN: 透视线从中央小孔扩展成四面网格，前进一段后向两边收窄，留出双标志的对称位置。

title.en: A computing scene dissolves into an emblem

summary.en: Place the cloud above and devices below, connecting the layers with a glowing vertical line. Dim surrounding terminal information and retain a central vertical composition.
summary.zh-CN: 云在上方，设备在下方，发光竖线连接两层。周围终端信息降低对比，主体保持纵向中央构图。

title.en: A brand symbol becomes a chat tool
title.zh-CN: Dia 开放给 Arc 会员

summary.en: Raise and shrink a glowing shape from the bottom, then turn it into a send arrow; expand the input horizontally to move naturally from brand introduction into interaction.
summary.zh-CN: 发光图形从底部升起并缩小，随后变为发送箭头；输入框沿水平方向展开，让品牌介绍自然进入操作。

title.en: A quiet website with playful cursor trails

summary.en: Keep the crest, short phrase and link centered, with sparse navigation in the page corners. Arc the blue cursor through negative space and return it to the central text as the sole moving focus.
summary.zh-CN: 纹章、短句和链接保持居中，页面四角保留少量导航。蓝色光标划弧经过留白，再回到中心文字，形成单一的动态焦点。

title.en: A keycap turns into voice typing

summary.en: Drop logo and letter keycaps into a row, then scatter them sideways to reveal a glowing black waveform capsule. The capsule becomes a shared anchor for subsequent demonstrations.
summary.zh-CN: 标志键帽与文字键帽落下排成一行，再向两边散开，露出发光的黑色声波胶囊。胶囊成为后续演示的共同锚点。

title.en: An unfolding device changes the note layout

summary.en: Bring a portrait phone into the center, rotate and expand it into two landscape columns; keep the list on one side and move details into the other. Carry the same note content across both aspect ratios.
summary.zh-CN: 竖屏手机居中进入，转向并展开为横向双栏；列表留在一侧，详情进入另一侧。保持同一条笔记内容贯穿两个画幅。

title.en: One product across a complete launch kit

summary.en: Show the final product page first, then return to the request, extract palette and product, generate scenes and sizes, and finally demonstrate motion capabilities. The same speaker recurs across outputs.
summary.zh-CN: 先给最终产品页，再倒回请求，提取配色与产品，生成场景和不同尺寸，最后展示动效能力。同一音箱在多个产物中反复出现。

title.en: Status words resolve into a wordmark

summary.en: Rapidly change dim monospace status words, then cut to a dark double triangle. Fill the mark upward with green before unfolding the white brand wordmark.
summary.zh-CN: 状态词用低亮度等宽字快速变化，接着切为暗色双三角。绿色从下方向上填入标志，再让白色品牌字标展开。

title.en: Recording opens into a multitrack arrangement

summary.en: After the red record button activates, grow the waveform from left to right; cut to the sound list and expand into multiple colored tracks. Recording progress and playhead move in the same direction.
summary.zh-CN: 红色录音按钮启动后，波形从左到右增长；切入声音列表，继续展开为多条彩色轨道。录制进度和播放头同向运动。

title.en: A large version reveal becomes a toggle

summary.en: Place V above and 6 below, with orange edges and pink interiors creating layered gloss. Keep the central brand name small and stable, revealing the control only after the version letters exit upward and downward.
summary.zh-CN: V 在上，6 在下，橙色边缘与粉色内部形成多层光泽。中间品牌名保持小而稳定，版本字向上下离开后才露出控件。

title.zh-CN: 网站、deck、发布图讲同一个故事

summary.en: After requesting a coffee website, ask for a presentation and launch graphics. All three outputs share photography, a brown palette and serif headings, demonstrating context reuse through content consistency.
summary.zh-CN: 输入创建咖啡网站后，继续要求演示稿和发布图。三类成果共享照片、褐色色盘与衬线标题，用内容一致性说明上下文复用。

title.en: Connections become a large tool ecosystem

summary.en: Orange capsules connect words such as connect and with, ending at a clickable plus. After clicking, stream icons along multiple arcs and increase the count to 450.
summary.zh-CN: 橙色胶囊把 connect、with 等词接起来，最终落到一个可点击加号。点击后图标沿多条弧线涌入，数字增长到 450。

title.en: Several creative formats in one editor

summary.en: Switch websites, whiteboards, portrait content and presentations within the same toolbar, using bottom thumbnails for navigation. Establish format coexistence before introducing specific new capabilities.
summary.zh-CN: 网站、白板、竖版内容和演示稿在相同工具栏内切换，底部缩略图负责导航。先证明格式共存，再进入具体新能力。

title.en: A prompt becomes a branded presentation

summary.en: Generate a cover, content and speaker notes after topic input, keeping thumbnails on the left throughout. Switch pages to show continuity in palette, typography and illustration language.
summary.zh-CN: 输入主题后生成封面、内容与讲稿，缩略图栏始终在左。逐页切换显示配色、字体和插画语言如何延续。

title.en: A paper geometry system for knowledge work

summary.en: Establish material through paper collage, continually recombining squares, circles and holes; introduce product cards around the central object to connect abstract graphics with projects, tasks and resources.
summary.zh-CN: 以纸面拼贴建立材质，方块、圆和孔洞不断重组；产品卡片围绕中心对象出现，让抽象图形与项目、任务和资源关系接在一起。

title.en: A cube opens to reveal a letter

summary.en: Rotate the cube and pull back first; after thin white seams appear along the edges, spread the faces outward. Keep H at the original center and increase separation until the panels leave the frame.
summary.zh-CN: 先旋转立方体并拉远，白色细缝沿边缘出现后，各面向外散开。H 留在原中心，分离距离逐渐加大到面板离开画幅。

title.en: An information field focuses into research

summary.en: Build a large oval from gray-purple and gray-green planes, with a task card near the central black dot. Gradually shrink the whole composition, revealing white circular openings outside while the black dot stays at frame center.
summary.zh-CN: 大椭圆由多个灰紫灰绿块面组成，任务卡靠近中心黑点。整体逐渐缩小，外侧出现白色圆洞，黑点保持在画面中心。

summary.en: Fill the first half with letters, strips and geometry of varied sizes; after the whole composition shrinks, move fragments toward the central word's baseline. Stagger outgoing elements and incoming letters.
summary.zh-CN: 前半段用不同大小的字母、条带和几何铺满画面，整体缩小后，碎片向中央单词的基线靠拢。元素退出与新字母出现错开进行。

title.en: A desktop tool shown through focused actions

summary.en: Start each section with the full window, then push into the current area: session tree, terminal, device testing, rule settings or PR. Fix captions below the image to explain that section's action.
summary.zh-CN: 每段先显示完整窗口，再推近当前区域：会话树、终端、设备测试、规则设置与 PR。字幕固定在画面下方说明这一段的操作。

title.en: Search, assess and hire one candidate

summary.en: Show candidates after skill-criteria input, open details for interviews and transcripts, then proceed through hiring, introductions and payment. Connect all steps through the same candidate.
summary.zh-CN: 输入技能条件后展示候选人，再打开详情看面试与文字记录，接着聘用、介绍和付款。用同一位候选人把多个步骤连起来。

summary.en: Keep the glass fixed as hands and containers pass behind it; the fine grid splits contours into offset segments. Wide shots establish the frame, while close-ups clarify the relationship between texture and distortion.
summary.zh-CN: 玻璃本身固定，手和容器从后方经过；细密方格把轮廓分成错位的小段。全景交代框架，近景让纹理与失真关系清楚可见。

title.zh-CN: Introducing Muse｜个人 AI 助理发布

summary.en: Connect assistant capabilities through three everyday tasks: understand requirements from messages, show ongoing work, and pause separately at decisions that require the user.
summary.zh-CN: 用三个生活任务串联助理能力：从消息理解需求，展示正在做什么，再把需要用户决定的环节单独停下来。

title.zh-CN: Own the means of production. Revolt with us.

summary.en: Rapidly pull an extreme logo and red-text close-up back into a small composition, leaving extensive black negative space for a brief brand reveal.
summary.zh-CN: 把极近的标志与红字快速拉回到小尺度组合；黑场留下大量空白，完成一次短促品牌亮相。

summary.en: Expand related business functions from a payment card, then move into bills and reports, connecting the same expense across views.
summary.zh-CN: 从一张支付卡展开相关业务，再推进到账单与报表界面，让同一笔消费在不同视图里连起来。

title.zh-CN: Databricks — GLM 5.3 Flash on the Lakehouse

summary.en: Select the new model from an existing list and synchronize its name with the brand announcement area.
summary.zh-CN: 让新模型从现有列表中被选中，并把同一名称同步到品牌公告位置。

summary.en: Make copy the protagonist: enlarge, squeeze in and connect short words according to semantic emphasis, using diamonds to push text sections into the next color group.
summary.zh-CN: 把文案当作主角：短词按语义重音放大、挤入和接续，菱形负责把文字段落推向下一组颜色。

summary.en: Retain five emphases within fifteen seconds: greeting, stance, music, creators and listeners; let viewers read one word group at a time.
summary.zh-CN: 在十五秒内保留致意、立场、音乐、创作者与听众五个重音；每次只读一组词。

summary.en: Make the domain's dot the transition protagonist: split a long URL, expand the dot into geometric scenes, then land on a shorter industry suffix.
summary.zh-CN: 把域名中的句点变成转场主角：长网址被拆开，句点放大成几何场景，最后落到更简短的行业后缀。

summary.en: Expand one input into cross-department workflows. Connect task cards, people and data sources with lines, then return results to a readable interface.
summary.zh-CN: 从一个输入框展开到跨部门工作流。任务卡、人物和数据源通过连线建立关系，结果回到可读的界面。

summary.en: First show the assistant understanding a personal task, then expand personal preferences into enterprise relationships among people, projects and data.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示助理理解个人任务，再把个人偏好扩展为人员、项目和数据的企业关系图。

summary.en: Use two rounds of specific requests to demonstrate scope: show the full prompt first, enter a scrollable website result, then unfold multiple designs into a spatial mosaic.
summary.zh-CN: 用两轮具体需求证明制作范围：提示词先完整出现，随后进入可滚动的网页结果，最后把多个作品展开为空间拼图。

summary.en: Show the range of available templates, enlarge one complete browsable website, then use a prompt to adapt it to another business.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示可选模板的范围，再放大一个能浏览的完整网站，最后用提示词把模板改成另一个业务。

summary.en: Turn repeated requirements into an invocable skill, using one palette change to prove it actually affects the page.
summary.zh-CN: 把重复交代的要求变成可调用的技能；用一次配色变化证明技能真正作用于页面。

summary.en: Pair each instruction with its canvas change: remix a template, arrange dots, offset tracks, then expand into different sizes and languages.
summary.zh-CN: 把一句操作要求与画布上的变化放在一起：重混模板、排列圆点、偏移轨道，最后扩展到不同尺寸和语言。

summary.en: Build the whole motion through text scale and alignment: reveal letterform details first, pull back to a complete phrase, then split it into a movable column of action words.
summary.zh-CN: 用字的尺度和对齐方式完成整段动效：先看到字形局部，再拉回完整短句，最后拆成一列可移动的动作词。

summary.en: Separate and reunite three notched effect buttons like interlocking modules, starting from the bottom item and preserving their tight vertical relationship.
summary.zh-CN: 让三个带缺口的效果按钮像可拼合的模块一样拆散再归位；顺序从底项开始，保留紧密的竖向关系。

summary.en: Continuously reshape symbols around one center, changing meaning through notches, holes and subdivisions rather than fading separate icons in one by one.
summary.zh-CN: 围绕同一个中心把符号连续改形，靠凹口、孔洞和分块改变含义，而不是让不同图标逐个淡入。

summary.en: Count down through three large numerals, then pull back into a nine-cell set, showing a shared family of angular strokes and rounded corners.
summary.zh-CN: 先用三个大数字连续倒计时，再拉开成为一套九宫格数字，展示同一家族的折线与圆角。

summary.en: Use a sphere as a visual guide through layered webpages, forms and workflow spaces. Interfaces are composable planes with depth rather than mere screenshots.
summary.zh-CN: 以球体作为视觉向导，在分层网页、表单和流程空间中穿行。界面不只是截图，而是具有前后距离的可组合平面。

title.zh-CN: Welcome to the Age of No-Code

summary.en: Through a dark-to-light spatial journey, transform tightly packed interface and code regions into an open creative world to explore.
summary.zh-CN: 通过一次从暗到亮的空间穿越，把紧密的界面与代码区域转成开放、可探索的创作世界。

summary.en: Preserve the same three-petal mark, switching internal materials first, then enlarging and shifting it on blue to make room for the product name and parameters.
summary.zh-CN: 保持同一三瓣标志，先切换内部材质，再在蓝色背景上放大移位，把空间让给产品名称与参数。

summary.en: Carry one logo contour across creative media: design interface, graffiti, images and miniature landscapes. Preserve the central shape at every material change.
summary.zh-CN: 一条标志轮廓贯穿多种创作媒介：先是设计界面，再是涂鸦、图像和微景观。每次换材质都保留中心形状。

summary.en: Use material cuts at the same position in under two seconds to connect green organic forms, landscapes and iridescent pipes into one logo family.
summary.zh-CN: 用不到两秒的同位置材质快切，把绿色有机形、景观和虹彩管道连接成同一个标志家族。

summary.en: Use brief cuts to show the logo moving from 3D slices to flat editing and silver-white material, with magenta linking all versions.
summary.zh-CN: 以短促快切展示标志从立体切片到平面编辑与银白材质的变化，玫红是贯穿各版本的视觉线索。

summary.en: Cycle one logo through creative styles, from fine lines, metal and flowers to image collage, using a unified position and negative space to make one series.
summary.zh-CN: 以同一个标志做创作风格轮播，从细线、金属和花卉到图像拼贴；统一的位置和留白把变化收成一个系列。

summary.en: Use orange-yellow as the thread through rapid cuts between hand-drawn, liquid, flexible-tube and flat floral styles, with the curved contour connecting all materials.
summary.zh-CN: 以橙黄为主线，在手绘、液态、软管与平面花卉之间快切；弧线轮廓始终把不同材质连在一起。

summary.en: Instantly unfold a colorful geometric world from fine contours in darkness, then gather everything back into the central mark.
summary.zh-CN: 从黑暗中的细轮廓瞬间展开一个多彩几何世界，再把所有东西收回中心标志。

summary.en: A sphere, circular disc and square plate form a compact rotating composition. The square moves around the center, with occlusion giving the planes spatial depth.
summary.zh-CN: 一颗球、一块圆片和一块方片组成紧凑的旋转构图。方片绕中心移动，遮挡关系让平面也有空间感。

summary.en: Transform four full-frame geometric patterns in sequence, shifting from the hard rhythm of folded corners to soft waves, then dots of varying sizes.
summary.zh-CN: 四组满幅几何纹样依次变化：折角的硬节奏转为柔软波浪，再落到不同大小的圆点。

summary.en: Carry one product project through goals, research, design and development. Preserve its name or key question at every view change so the long video reads as one advancing workflow.
summary.zh-CN: 用同一个产品项目贯穿目标、研究、设计与开发。每次换视图都保留项目名称或关键问题，让长片读成一个持续推进的工作流程。

summary.en: Show the burden of queues and review reminders first, then turn the list into a board ordered by urgency, recent changes and progress. Orange continuously tracks the item needing attention most.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示排队与催审带来的负担，再把列表转为按紧急程度、近期变化和推进情况排序的看板。橙色始终追踪最需要处理的一项。

summary.en: Reveal a new product name with a green light sweep, keeping transparent layers and dark aurora restrained; finally turn the name into two short promises.
summary.zh-CN: 用一道绿色扫光揭开新产品名称，透明层和暗色极光保持克制；最后将产品名转成两句短承诺。

summary.en: Explain the assistant's value through one complete booking exchange: the user requests a time, the assistant offers two options, and the user confirms one.
summary.zh-CN: 用一次完整的预约对话说明助理价值：用户提出时间需求，助理给出两个选择，用户确认其中一个。

title.zh-CN: Exa — Give Codex and ChatGPT access to 100B+ websites

summary.en: Pose a specific question requiring external information, then show a search call and structured answer; summarize integration capability only at the end.
summary.zh-CN: 先提出一个需要外部资料的具体问题，再展示搜索调用和结构化回答；结尾才概括集成能力。

summary.en: Break software production into stages first, then enter a metrics workbench in the same order. Every opening stage word must have a counterpart in the actual interface later.
summary.zh-CN: 先把软件生产拆成一组工序，再进入同样顺序的指标工作台。开场的工序词必须在后面的真实界面里找到对应。

summary.en: Turn a sentence into connected, thick word blocks. Use their fronts for reading and sides for iridescent material, looping back to the same front-facing pose.
summary.zh-CN: 把一句话做成有厚度的连通字块。正面用于阅读，侧面用于展示虹彩材质；循环回到同一正面姿态。

summary.en: Extract a C from an enlarged iridescent surface, condense the spatial form into one letter, then unfold the full brand name along the same baseline.
summary.zh-CN: 从放大的虹彩表面抽出 C 形，把空间形体收回一个字，再沿同一基线展开完整品牌名。

title.zh-CN: Goodfire — Understand and debug your AI model

summary.en: Make model inspection a research process viewers can follow: establish the subject and dataset, confirm the inspection plan, then present findings and the next experiment.
summary.zh-CN: 把模型检查做成可跟随的研究过程：先明确对象和数据集，再确认检查计划，最后给出发现及下一步实验。

title.zh-CN: Persimmon — a model that simulates people

summary.en: Use one fruit poster to represent an individual, then pull back into many differentiated samples; let particles cross poster boundaries to tell a story from individuality to interaction.
summary.zh-CN: 先用一张果实海报表现个体，再拉开成许多差异化样本；让粒子跨越海报边界，完成从个体到互动的叙事。

summary.en: Move the same work among desktop, tablet and phone, carrying documents, charts and collaborators through transitions before condensing into a branded paper plane.
summary.zh-CN: 同一份工作在桌面、平板与手机之间流动；把文档、图表和协作者保留在转场中，最后收成品牌纸飞机。

title.zh-CN: OKX AI — AI agents can already work, create, and earn.

summary.en: Expand from one person to a group of agents, then enter service selection and fulfillment. Carry purple blocks through people, directory and selected states to preserve one action thread.
summary.zh-CN: 从一个人扩展到一组代理，再进入服务选择和履约过程。紫色块贯穿人物、目录与选中状态，保持同一个行动主线。

summary.en: Start with a business question, break it into queryable facts, then assemble facts into an actionable table. Orange marks only the question focus and final priority.
summary.zh-CN: 从一个业务问题出发，拆成可查询的事实，再把事实拼成可行动的表格。橙色只标记问题焦点和最终优先级。

title.zh-CN: Parallel Index — get paid when AI uses your content

summary.en: Explain network changes through node organization: open connections, new visitors, growth from one visit to large-scale traffic, then contraction into an index mark.
summary.zh-CN: 用节点的组织方式讲网络变化：先是开放连接，再出现新的访问者，随后从单次访问扩成大规模流量，最终收成索引标志。

summary.en: Use a short phrase about the web's memory as the central axis, layering knowledge illustrations before early webpages so accumulated content naturally leads into the browser era.
summary.zh-CN: 用一句关于网络记忆的短句作为中轴，先叠入知识插画，再叠入早期网页，让内容积累自然过渡到浏览器时代。

title.en: Parallel Web Systems — Agents and context

summary.en: Use minimal text and thin rings to shift attention from the agent to the context it depends on.
summary.zh-CN: 用极少的文字和细圆环，把注意力从代理引向它依赖的上下文。

summary.en: Break the old graphic into its smallest units, then reassemble the mark and name using the same colors.
summary.zh-CN: 把旧图形拆成最小单元，再用同一组颜色重新组装标志与名称。

title.zh-CN: Introducing Prime Agent: A self-improving RLM harness for coding and long-running …

summary.en: Introduce product mechanisms through code and states, then conclude with task results and summary figures.
summary.zh-CN: 让产品机制先通过代码与状态出现，再用任务结果和汇总数字收束。

summary.en: Push a quiet dark inbox into the foreground, then complete the launch reveal with a giant heading and backlight.
summary.zh-CN: 把一个安静的深色收件箱推到前景，再用巨大标题与背光完成发布揭示。

title.zh-CN: We’re rolling out EURR, our first euro-backed stablecoin, in the Revolut app.

summary.en: Exchange two coins' front-back positions along one tray, keeping text fixed so motion is concentrated between the two subjects.
summary.zh-CN: 双币沿同一个托盘交换前后位置，文字固定，让动感集中在两枚主体之间。

summary.en: Show app generation through side-by-side requests and results, then bring attachment updates and other business examples into the same structure.
summary.zh-CN: 用请求与结果并排的方式展示应用生成，再把附件更新和其他业务案例接进同一语法。

summary.en: Demonstrate customization through multiple interactive interfaces, ending each example with clear feedback.
summary.zh-CN: 通过多个能操作的界面说明自定义能力，每个例子用一次明确反馈收尾。

summary.en: Fix the brand name's position while icons, version numbers and product suffixes change in sequence, finally returning to the main brand alone.
summary.zh-CN: 固定品牌名的位置，让图标、版本号和产品后缀接力变化，最后回归纯粹的主品牌。

title.en: Cash App — Bank on Cash App.

summary.en: Connect benefits through the same phone, using black, gray and fluorescent green background changes for section rhythm.
summary.zh-CN: 用同一手机串联利益点，黑、灰、荧光绿背景切换承担章节节奏。

summary.en: Use a stable multi-cell grid for varied small loops, rotating messages only in the narrow right column to give rich assets a reading order.
summary.zh-CN: 稳定的多格网格容纳不同小循环，只有右侧窄栏轮换主张，让丰富素材仍有阅读顺序。

title.zh-CN: Telegram managed bots (AI bots) — On Telegram, anyone…

summary.en: Use one fixed phone to complete bot creation, testing and profile viewing, connecting states through click feedback.
summary.zh-CN: 用一台固定手机走完机器人创建、测试与查看资料，点击反馈连接每个状态。

summary.en: Bring 3D letters from scattered orientations into one reading direction, then hold a quiet wordmark after the brief assembly.
summary.zh-CN: 立体字母从分散朝向归到同一阅读方向，短促完成后保留安静的字标。

summary.en: Alternate close-ups and full forms of the same filament material, unfolding product suffixes and capability words in groups that follow each shape.
summary.zh-CN: 同一细丝材质在近景与整体之间切换，产品后缀和能力词跟随不同形态分组展开。

title.en: Uber — PLAN ON A GOOD TIME
title.zh-CN: Uber Go Get It｜品牌图形动效片段

summary.en: Slide and flip repeated suitcases around a fixed short phrase, keeping the travel message readable within a continuous pattern.
summary.zh-CN: 重复行李箱围绕固定短句滑动与翻转，让旅行主张在连续图案中保持可读。

title.zh-CN: 钱包补充资金的插画循环

summary.en: Borrow the act of refueling for a wallet: aim the nozzle, let coins flow in and fill the wallet, using the action itself to explain topping up.
summary.zh-CN: 把“加油”动作借给钱包：枪口对准、金币流入、钱包充盈，动作本身解释充值含义。

title.en: Wabi — A new kind of messenger
title.zh-CN: Introducing Wabi 2.0: a new kind of messenger that makes apps and gets things done…

summary.en: Let information in chat progressively become usable mini-apps, then assemble those apps into a personal homepage.
summary.zh-CN: 聊天中的信息逐渐长成可用的小应用，再让这些应用组成个人首页。

title.zh-CN: Whop — Introducing Whop Treasury: Earn 6% Yield on…

summary.en: Change account composition through one balance transfer, then expand the product explanation with charts and a funding menu.
summary.zh-CN: 一次余额转移动作改变账户构成，再用图表与入金菜单扩展产品说明。

summary.en: Move from material close-ups into a phone interface, then extend the same rounded corners and transparent layers to icons, widgets and multiple devices.
summary.zh-CN: 从材质特写进入手机界面，再把相同圆角和透明层扩展到图标、小组件与多设备。

summary.en: Keep input materials and generated results visible together, using sketches, images and screen recordings to demonstrate distinct visual-input capabilities.
summary.zh-CN: 保持输入材料和生成结果同时可见，让草图、图片和录屏分别证明不同的视觉输入能力。

title.zh-CN: 用 AI 创建演示文稿

summary.en: Turn a topic into an editable outline, then the outline into a complete slide set, giving each generation step a clear result.
summary.zh-CN: 先把主题变成可编辑大纲，再把大纲变成一组完整幻灯片，让两次生成各有清楚结果。

summary.en: Show the wordmark's geometric construction first, then turn curved modules into standalone symbols and app icons.
summary.zh-CN: 先展示字标的几何构造，再把圆弧模块变成独立符号和应用图标。

summary.en: Use a garden and bee swarm as metaphors for computing: large text states the message while tiny colored process blocks remain active around it.
summary.zh-CN: 用花园与蜂群比喻计算系统：大字给主张，彩色微型进程块在周围持续活动。

title.en: Cloudera — Your journey to enterprise AI

summary.en: Place enterprise-data questions within a journey with a starting point, obstacles and converging paths, ending with the same group of characters heading toward a shared destination.
summary.zh-CN: 把企业数据的疑问放进一段有起点、障碍和汇流的旅程，最终用同一队角色走向共同目的地。

summary.en: Move from constructing logos, palettes and letterforms to brand applications, then connect webpages and messages through the same floating sphere.
summary.zh-CN: 从标志、配色和字形的构造走向品牌应用，再用同一颗漂浮球把网页与主张连接起来。

summary.en: Frame one video-editing request as an explicit asset handoff: select a preset, supply video, confirm layout, supply brand guidelines, then show results in two ratios.
summary.zh-CN: 把一次视频编辑请求讲成明确的材料交接：选预设、交视频、确认版式、交品牌指南，最后展示两种比例的结果。

summary.en: Demonstrate vector generation's value at three scales: editable paths, work categories and real applications, then return to generating stylistically consistent variants.
summary.zh-CN: 让矢量生成的价值从路径可编辑性、作品类别和真实载体三个尺度展开，最后回到同风格的变体生成。

title.zh-CN: Rive CLI — build Rive files with your agent

summary.en: Demonstrate interaction through works that genuinely change state, with games, controls, design systems and a sequencer each showing one clear action.
summary.zh-CN: 用一连串真正发生状态变化的作品说明交互能力：游戏、控件、设计系统和音序器各演示一个清楚动作。

summary.en: Represent collaboration between clinicians and tools with two sets of fine lines, merging them into a visual thread through real care scenes.
summary.zh-CN: 把临床人员与工具的协作用两组细线表达，线束交汇后变成贯穿真实照护场景的视觉线索。

summary.en: Open the product through a growth chart, then demonstrate queries, saving, natural language and local workflows in turn, keeping short phrases beside the feature being shown.
summary.zh-CN: 先用增长图打开产品，再逐项证明查询、保存、自然语言和本地工作流，短句始终与正在演示的功能并置。

summary.en: Connect a data source to the conversation through one enable action: open the menu, enable the connector, ask a source-specific question, then end with both brands.
summary.zh-CN: 一次启用动作把数据源接入对话：打开菜单、开启连接器、输入针对该数据源的问题，再以双品牌组合结束。

title.zh-CN: Supabase Pipelines — near real-time analytics sync

summary.en: Visualize traffic pressure first, then explain division of responsibilities through destination configuration and continuous synchronization, giving the product a clear cause and effect.
summary.zh-CN: 先把流量压力画出来，再通过配置目标和持续同步解释分工，让产品作用有明确的前因与后果。

summary.en: Make the funding amount a visual event first, then explain growth through investors and global reach, returning to product positioning at the end.
summary.zh-CN: 先把融资金额做成视觉事件，再用投资方和全球覆盖解释这次增长，最后回到产品定位。

summary.en: Use an uncontrollably duplicating desktop to represent busywork, then let one switch organize all the noise into a few completed workflows.
summary.zh-CN: 用复制失控的桌面表现繁杂工作，再让一个开关把所有噪声整理成少量完成的流程。

summary.en: Move from a launch object to one partner's earnings, then expand to the full recruitment funnel and detailed analysis, using an individual result to introduce product data.
summary.zh-CN: 从发布物件进入一个伙伴的收益，再扩大到整个招募漏斗和明细分析，用个人结果承接产品数据。

title.zh-CN: Mintlify Widget — an embedded agent that supports your users anywhere

summary.en: Connect questions, answers and sources through one lightweight entry point, integrating the assistant naturally into the existing page.
summary.zh-CN: 用一个轻量入口连接提问、回答和资料来源，让助手功能自然嵌入现有页面。

title.zh-CN: Twilio｜客户互动平台 MG 介绍

summary.en: Bring brand dots into human and everyday scenes, connecting customer stories through shared lines, red objects and positional handoffs.
summary.zh-CN: 让品牌圆点进入人物和生活场景，通过相同的连线、红色物件与位置接力串起多个客户故事。

summary.en: Animate individual soundwaves independently before combining them into a stable heart mark.
summary.zh-CN: 让独立声波先各自动起来，再共同组成一个稳定的心形标记。

title.zh-CN: Deezer｜Live the Music 动态背景

summary.en: Keep background waves breathing continuously while the central heading stays clearly fixed in one position.
summary.zh-CN: 让背景波形持续呼吸，中央标题始终清楚地停在同一个位置。

summary.en: Carry three messages on slowly flowing color fields, briefly breaking letterforms only between sentences.
summary.zh-CN: 用缓慢流动的色域承载三句主张，只在换句时短暂打散字形。

summary.en: Connect geometric patterns, real-world scenes and branding through the same dot-matrix medium.
summary.zh-CN: 用同一种点阵媒介连接几何纹样、现实场景和品牌标记。

summary.en: Assemble scattered particles into a readable sentence, then disassemble it using the same particles.
summary.zh-CN: 让零散颗粒拼成一句可阅读的话，再用同一批颗粒拆开。

summary.en: Explain the typeface's origins, show glyph details, then apply the same typography to different currencies and palettes.
summary.zh-CN: 先说明字体从哪里来，再展示字形细节，最后把同一套字应用到不同货币和配色中。
